_comments: bizapps-sales#314 (and the Payment schedule part of #286): the deal's Payment schedule grid had
no DefaultInView field, so MJ showed the first ten fields: Deal ID, the deal's name and Display
Order. A rep reads an instalment as date, amount and description; those three are the grid.
DisplayOrder is left off on purpose. It is the collection's sequence, used by the deal workspace
and as the form grid's tie-break within a date. Rows added through the form grid save it as 0, so
the number tells a rep nothing there. It stays available from the grid's column chooser.
